🏀 GAME DAY: Wemby and France Take on Jokic and Serbia TONIGHT

Victor Wembanyama is wearing the captain's armband for Team France tonight in Belgrade — and the opponent is a Serbian squad featuring Nikola Jokic.

This is Wemby's first game since France's historic run to the 2024 Olympic final. At 22 years old, he's already leading his national team. And his excitement? Completely genuine.

"I do not miss the NBA right now," Wembanyama said, "but I miss FIBA basketball."

The two-time defensive player of the year candidate against the three-time NBA MVP. The long frame versus the maestro passer. Two players who could define international basketball for the next decade — on the same court, tonight.

France also has Rudy Gobert and Evan Fournier to support Wemby. Serbia has the full depth you'd expect from one of Europe's powerhouse programs.

Tip is at 2 PM ET (8 PM local Belgrade time). Worth your afternoon.

🇫🇷 France vs. 🇷🇸 Serbia | Tonight at 2 PM ET

🚨 Kawhi Leonard Investigation: A Major Update

The NBA has found no evidence that Clippers owner Steve Ballmer personally funneled money to Kawhi Leonard.

That's a significant development — and it brings the long-awaited trade to the Toronto Raptors meaningfully closer.

Here's where things stand:
• The NBA cleared Leonard personally of violations
• The investigation into the Daktronics scoreboard deal (alleged salary cap circumvention involving the Clippers) is ongoing
• Some level of sanctions against the Clippers is still expected
• But: the trade itself appears to be moving toward completion
• Leonard expects to be in Toronto before training camp (Sept. 28, Quebec City)

After months of waiting, Raptors fans may finally be on the verge of getting their man back. Kawhi helped bring Toronto its only NBA championship in 2019 — and now, seven years later, a reunion looks imminent.

The question is timing. Could it happen this week? Next week? Sources expect resolution within weeks.

Stay tuned. This one's almost done. 🦖

Warriors expected to offer 2 years, $136.7M. All signs point to a deal. Steph finishing his career in Golden State. #Warriors #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Posting window: 9:00 AM ET

⏰ STEPHEN CURRY: 9 DAYS LEFT

Nine days. That's the countdown until Stephen Curry becomes eligible to sign a max contract extension with the Golden State Warriors on August 29.

The expected terms: two years, $136.7 million — which would carry the greatest shooter in NBA history through his age-40 season.

Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy Jr. has said he's "pretty confident" Curry will finish his career in Golden State. League sources confirm there's strong mutual interest. ESPN's Anthony Slater reported both sides are on the same page.

Without this extension, Curry would be an unrestricted free agent in 2027 — for the first time in his entire career. That's not a scenario either side wants to see.

The deal isn't done. But everything points to Steph staying a Warrior for life.

Nine days. 🏆

Anthony Edwards on the Timberwolves' chances vs. OKC and the Spurs this season:

"Against those two teams, I think we're going to beat them."

LaMelo just arrived. Ant's already in midseason form with the trash talk. #Timberwolves #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Posting window: 1:00 PM ET

🔥 Anthony Edwards is NOT playing around this offseason

Anthony Edwards is already talking championship with LaMelo Ball as his new backcourt partner.

"Against those two teams [the Thunder and the Spurs]," Edwards told ESPN, "I think we're going to beat them."

That's a bold statement. Oklahoma City just came off an incredible season. San Antonio and Victor Wembanyama are still the class of the Western Conference in many people's eyes.

But here's what Edwards has going for him:
• He led the entire NBA with 157 clutch points in 2024-25
• LaMelo Ball's arrival gives him a playmaker to play off of, instead of always being the initiator
• He's entering his prime and has playoff experience

The Timberwolves made an enormous bet when they shipped Naz Reid and multiple picks to Charlotte for LaMelo. Edwards is already showing he knows the stakes.

If he and LaMelo figure it out fast? Minnesota could absolutely be a problem in the West. 🐺
